name: atebites-plugins
description: atebites-hub plugin catalog for Claude Code: open-dynamic-workflows, ponytail, Advisor, taskboard, j-space, superpowers, factory-policy (v1 warn-default; not a Factory default), and gitnexus (Upcoming / P N wrap; not a Factory default). GitHub plugin sources for the four forks and the Superpowers pin; j-space, factory-policy, and gitnexus are in-repo wraps.

plugins.name: open-dynamic-workflows
plugins.description: Native orchestration guidance only: ultracode. Preserves the selected model; no workflow MCP on this host.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Forces the laziest solution that works. YAGNI, stdlib first, one line over fifty.

plugins.name: advisor
plugins.description: Advisor guidance for Claude Code: experimental detection; strict delegation disabled until resolved effort is authoritative.

plugins.name: taskboard
plugins.description: Per-repo Taskboard MCP, sprint-ticket skill, and fail-open session/commit hooks.

plugins.name: j-space
plugins.description: Inference-time workspace control for long-horizon work: selective loading, ledger at seams, named verification, and recovery.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Core skills library for Claude Code: TDD, debugging, collaboration patterns, and proven techniques.

plugins.name: factory-policy
plugins.description: v1 warn-default; not a Factory default. Catalog-listed for pin install until QA fail-mode VERDICT.

plugins.name: gitnexus
plugins.description: Upcoming / P N wrap; not a Factory default. Catalog-listed for pin install. Pins gitnexus@1.6.7.
